_help: STORM case file template (new format). One file per 999 call. Copy, fill, add to calls/active and list it in calls/manifest.json. Full field guide: calls/CASE_SCHEMA.md. The file is ground truth: the AI caller never invents beyond it and QA scores the player against it. Locations: declare locationTypes (real places resolved live from OpenStreetMap at spawn: train_station, residential_road, supermarket, pub, a_road, shopping_centre, car_park, park, school, office, stadium, high_street...). Use {{address}}, {{town}}, {{place}}, {{postcode}} placeholders in openingLine, summaryTruth, fact values and beats. A fixed location block is an optional override for cases that must pin to one place.
category: burglary | domestic | robbery | theft | weapons | asb | roads | missing | drugs | publicorder | suspicious | fraud | police
title: Shown in supervisor QA, never mid-call

caller.persona: one line of voice direction, e.g. frightened, whispering
caller.openingLine: What they say the moment the call connects
dontKnowLines: In-character lines for questions they cannot answer

location: OPTIONAL fixed override, normally omitted. Same shape as before: {line, town, postcode, lat, lng, callerKnowsPostcode}

incident.summaryTruth: Full ground-truth narrative. Every fact the caller can ever reveal.

facts.label: QA label
facts.cardField: callerName | addressLine | town | postcode | incidentType | summary

unknownTopics: topics the caller genuinely cannot answer
unitRequirements: Taser | AFO | TPAC | PO2 | K9 | CUS

escalations.text: Template update line in an on-scene unit or second caller voice

_people_note: People generate fresh per spawn from these specs; see calls/CASE_SCHEMA.md for the token list ({{callerName}}, {{s_he}}, {{p_son}}, {{vehicleReg}}...).

deployment._comment: MissionChief-mirrored requirements. Classes: patrol, patrol_or_arv, arv, traffic, dsu, psu, mounted, eiu, helicopter, heli_or_drone. Personnel kinds: armed, po1, po2, sergeant, inspector, officers. See CASE_SCHEMA.md.
